court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
trial_court: Court of Principal Judge, Family Court, Kanpur Nagar (Case No. 1543 of 2023)
case_name: Smt. Prachi Dixit vs Ashish Pandey
facts_of_case: The parties were married in 2023, but the husband filed for divorce due to matrimonial discord. The wife filed a written statement and then withdrew it, leading to rejection by the trial court. She then filed another written statement which was also rejected.

legal_principles.principle: The court should consider an additional written statement independently in accordance with law.
legal_principles.held: Submission is that, whatever might be, once an additional written statement dated 06.01.2026 and it is the part of the record, whether numbered or not, by the court below, consideration of the same is to be done independently in accordance with law.

legal_principles.principle: A party cannot resile from admissions made in a written statement.
legal_principles.held: Further contention is that while deciding the said application, the court below on 15.11.2025 rejected the said request but accorded liberty to file additional written statement which should be clarificatory in nature, and again the same mistake was committed on 28.8.2024 and then an order came to be passed on 09.12.2025 rejecting the additional written statement dated 28.08.2024, according liberty and leaving it open for the defendant-petitioner to file an additional written statement, which should be clarificatory in nature and once the defendant-petitioner has on 6.1.2026 filed an additional written statement, then the court below be directed to consider the same strictly in accordance with law bearing in mind that the admissions made may not be resiled.

outcome.final_order: The final order is not specified in this excerpt.
